youtube_full.title: The Ancient of Days | Bedtime Scripture Story for Kids | Daniel 7:13–14
youtube_full.description:
The Ancient of Days: a bedtime scripture story for kids from Daniel 7:13–14.

Daniel had a special dream. He saw royal chairs called thrones set in place.

Tonight's Scripture Traveler: Scout the Seeker.

Read along as the pages turn, then answer the bedtime questions together.

0:00 Opening the book
0:11 The story: The Ancient of Days
1:14 Scripture Traveler of the Night: Scout the Seeker
1:52 A Feeling Moment and the Five Stones
3:02 Question time
3:19 Sweet dreams
3:36 More stories, the app and the paperback
